# Source and local modifications

- Upstream: https://github.com/Supreeeme/xrizer, commit `0989a7fac2d1efb7ea82f5fe1a8ed30c3eeb9596`, GPL-3.0-or-later. Its LICENSE and bundled notices are retained in `upstream/`.
- Unmodified source verification: SHA-256 `0093b9e049460f0ff234d798c6b416693b8b0e965206f315af2ea04b451b31f3` of the byte stream generated by `git archive --format=tar 0989a7fac2d1efb7ea82f5fe1a8ed30c3eeb9596`. This is a Git-generated tar stream hash, not a GitHub download hash.
- `apple-port.patch` records all modifications inside `upstream/`, relative to that commit. SHA-256 `b0c0b6a74774369c282882fe860a223027e604c662ff58426d1b2acc19828a5f`.
- Fifteen files changed: staticlib and Apple platform build metadata; Apple gating for GLX, Linux desktop error UI and Vulkan overlay shader generation; an explicit Apple initialization error until a real native provider is implemented; an isolated OpenXR Metal Graphics binding with mock dispatch test, and an isolated Metal host copy bridge with mock resource-lifetime tests. A Metal backend and explicit provider registration support an owned-test route; the ordinary Apple initialization remains unavailable. A native xrizer frontend stereo fixture has passed with injected host state; Windows guest ABI, physical headset and actual game remain unverified. No AVP Play patches applied.
- String scan of upstream finds no ReactOS references. Wine is named in `src/openxr_data.rs` process-name detection; OpenComposite is credited in the README and cited in `src/misc_unknown.rs`, `src/compositor.rs`, and `src/system.rs`. This text scan does not establish full source or transitive dependency provenance; review remains necessary against project rules.
